name: DrakesOmniConfig-Nodes
description: Node rules end to end. NR-00 uploads rules/node-tests.yaml through the real admin path (parse, save to disk, reload, publish over ServerSync, receive), each test then drives a real game action (equip, consume, pickup, craft, hit, durability) and checks what the rule did, and NR-99 deletes the file again. Trigger items are ones no other suite uses, so a crashed run cannot change other mods' tests.
